text:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — CortexAI's onboarding acceptance run just finished and we missed the latency SLO (p95) on the prod-like test by ~220ms on the peak window. Customer is asking for a clear explanation + whether credits are due before renewal. Can SRE + CS Ops help pull the evidence + draft comm? :raising_hand:

Devon (SRE): I can grab traces and the SLI slice. Initial look shows a bunch of contiguous 95th spikes ~09:12-09:20 UTC tied to model warmup and a queuing surge. Quick mitigation: bump burst capacity for their Dedicated pool and enable prefix KV cache for the problematic route. Running a repro now.

Omar (Solutions): cc @Maya @Devon — is this the same test traffic pattern we gave them? If yes we should surface how our test differs from their steady-state production. Also need the request volumes to calc credit exposure.

OnboardBot: Evidence bundle created: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/cortexai/evidence/1633046400 — includes p95/p99 graphs, raw traces, and the acceptance test script. (action: evidence-ready)

Ruth (CS Ops): For credits calc, we'll need: total requests in the impacted interval, baseline SLO, measured SLO breach %, and contract term. Our formula: credit = committed_monthly_fee * breach_fraction * prorate_factor. If someone can paste the interval counts I can do a quick estimate. Also: should we offer a one-time operational credit + a runbook commit?

Devon (SRE): Pulled counts: 24,800 requests between 09:10-09:25 UTC; p95 jumped from 180ms -> 400ms. Command I used to pull the window: `redwood metrics query --service=cortexai-dedicated --metric=latency_p95 --start=2021-10-01T09:10:00Z --end=2021-10-01T09:25:00Z`

Maya (CSM): Thanks. Ruth — please draft a short customer note saying: 1) what happened (warmup + queueing), 2) what we fixed (burst + cache + followup run), 3) proposed credit (ballpark) and 4) next steps + timeline. I'll review before sending. Devon/Omar — can you confirm the followup run results by EOD PST? If followup passes we'll offer a 1-week credit cap and an enablement session on config tuning.

Omar (Solutions): I'll run an isolated synthetic with the exact acceptance script and share the run link. If the repro still shows variance I'll propose a tuned autoscale policy and a shorter model warmup config.

Devon (SRE): Followup run scheduled (09:55 UTC). If it passes I'll post updated graphs to the evidence bundle and mark the incident resolved; if not, I'll open a bug to escalate to runtime-eng.

Ruth (CS Ops): Drafting customer note now. Will include an example line for the credit calc and attach the evidence bundle link. ETA 45m.

Maya (CSM): Perfect — thanks team. If anyone sees anything customer-visible before my send, ping me in thread. :thumbsup:
